title: Sourdough Cranberry Orange Muffins

components.name: Dry Ingredients
ingredients: 2 cups dried, fresh, or frozen cranberries

components.name: Wet Ingredients
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120g) avocado oil or other neutral oil (not olive oil)
1 1/2 tbsp orange zest (from about 2 large oranges)

components.name: Orange Icing
directions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a muffin tin with paper liners.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together all dry ingredients except cranberries. Set aside.
In a separate bowl, whisk together all wet ingredients until smooth.
Pour the dry ingredients into the wet and mix until just combined. Do not over-mix. Fold in cranberries.
Use an ice cream scoop to fill the liners to the top.
Bake for 5 minutes at 425°F. Lower temperature to 350°F and bake for 15–18 more minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Remove from oven and cool completely in the muffin tin. Whisk together powdered sugar and orange juice; drizzle over cooled muffins.

notes: Yields about 16 muffins. Dried cranberries: soak in hot water 15–20 minutes, drain, and pat dry before adding. Do not thaw frozen cranberries — fold in frozen.
